scope: Offline labels and small frozen-state decisions, not navigation training or KDA V9.
collector: Inherited legal-observation ORCA teacher; include every terminal outcome.
probe: Train-only standardization, identical 256 radial-basis landmarks and ridge family. Hyperparameters selected on validation only.
decision_root: First frame at or after 6 seconds with all five humans visible and robot more than 1 metre from goal. No replacement when absent.
decision_reference: Native reward to terminal under each fixed legal ORCA continuation; Q^pi, not Q*. No added progress reward.
prediction_world: Keep current visible geometry/dynamics fixed; replace only hidden goals and prior preferred velocities with probe estimates. CV is a separate constant-velocity baseline.
confirmation: No navigation model training in this audit; results do not constitute a method admission.
